entries.name: Auto Model classifier and routing fallbacks

source.observation: model-routing completion classifier chooses allowed candidates; single-candidate/policy fallback skips classification.

limitations: Using fixed custom model does not exercise Auto routing or its classifier.
Policy, feature flags and account state can make path unavailable.
neededVerification: With explicitly supported isolated config, prove classifier request vs deterministic skip, chosen model, continuation and fallback behavior.

entries.name: Independent command-risk classification model

source.observation: command-risk-classification one-shot completion; classifier selector can be off, jev or luna; model, cache and parse/schema failure paths are separate.

limitations: Native approval UI is not this classifier. Availability/configuration is conditional; fixed main custom model does not imply routing of classifier request.
neededVerification: If public configuration supports enabling it under authorized BYOK, run harmless command cases and prove classifier route/output; otherwise mark blocked/unknown without patching feature flags.

entries.name: Droid Shield learned classification models

source.observation: droid-shield-classification completion uses risk/downgrade models, response_format, logprobs/top_logprobs and fallback behavior.

limitations: Bridge Anthropic Messages/native-agent semantics do not establish support for this specialized classification response contract.
Availability/configuration is conditional and untested.
neededVerification: Use officially exposed enabled configuration only; prove request route, required logprobs/JSON response and resulting decision, or explicitly mark unsupported.

entries.name: Local Signals analytics classifications and reused-prefix sidechain

source.observation: local-signals-classification constant; compaction/todo_completion/session_end triggers; reused prompt-prefix and one-shot completion code paths.

limitations: Hook/SessionEnd tests do not prove this analytics classifier executed.
Policy/feature flags/account configuration may gate it. No all-egress trace establishes absence.
neededVerification: Observe officially enabled isolated trigger and model usage; distinguish reused prefix vs one-shot; if inaccessible mark unknown.

entries.name: GenerateImage model tool and image-edit model requests

limitations: Not validated by text-only GLM BYOK. Image-generation model output is outside current proven bridge capabilities.

exactInvocationGuidance.specLimits: New sessions only. Do not combine --session-id/--fork with --use-spec/--spec-model.
exactInvocationGuidance.review: Interactive droid, then /review. No dedicated --review flag is advertised. droid "review app.tsx" is an ordinary prompt, not equivalent flow evidence.
exactInvocationGuidance.customDroid: Interactive /droids manages project/personal definitions. Runtime child invocation is actual Factory Task({subagent_type:<available catalog identifier>, description, prompt, ...}); no user-facing --droid/--agent flag was found in captured help.

historicalCaveats: Mission status is PASS_WITH_RECOVERY, not uninterrupted pass.
No real Claude subscription was accessed; GLM BYOK does not establish subscription cache, billing or account-enforcement safety.
Factory model configuration/header role is not sufficient evidence of actual task identity.
Factory Summarizer and Task summary helpers are distinct from Claude Code native compaction.
Published evidence contains historical unverified fields which later evidence supersedes; this inventory points at the newer specific evidence where applicable.
No complete all-process network egress capture was performed. Non-observation in Bridge logs cannot prove a request did not bypass Bridge.
